purpose: Teach: シーア/難関/人民元/ウイグル/最高峰/浙江/広州/天空

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、シーア派患者の医療配慮を医療チームで意識します
lines.en: Ren — we're committed to culturally sensitive care for Shia patients across our entire medical team.
lines.style: Clear and steady, speaking to Ren directly. Professional but warm. The tone of someone making a promise she intends to keep. Measured pace, full attention.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、最難関の手術にも医療チームで挑みます
lines.en: Yes — we approach even the most complex surgeries as a unified team effort.
lines.style: Affirming nod in the voice. Patient, unhurried. The confidence of experience without arrogance. Slight emphasis on 'unified' — this is deliberate practice, not accident.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 人民元での医療費請求を、貴院、検討されてますね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital is already considering billing in Chinese yuan, isn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Thoughtful, genuinely curious. Not quite a question, more like Ren thinking aloud. Respectful 'sensei' acknowledges her expertise. Slightly tentative, like he's testing whether he's understood something correctly.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、ウイグル系患者の通訳を医療チームで手配します
lines.en: Yes — we arrange professional interpreters for Uyghur-speaking patients within our medical team structure.
lines.style: Same clear, patient register as before. Factual but not cold. Slight warmth when mentioning the interpreter provision — this matters to her. Steady eye-level delivery.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療技術の最高峰を医療チームで目指します
lines.en: Ren — our team is always reaching for the highest standards in medical practice and innovation.
lines.style: Direct to Ren. Calm, foundational tone — this isn't new optimism, it's how the team operates. No rush. The voice of someone who has built something intentional.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 浙江省の漢方医学を、貴院、参考にされてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital draws on traditional Chinese medicine from Zhejiang Province, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, not skepticism. Ren asking carefully, respectfully. The 'sensei' carries real deference. Soft, exploratory pace — he's genuinely wondering what she'll say.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、広州医科大学と医療チームで交流します
lines.en: Yes — we actively collaborate with Guangzhou Medical University to keep our team at the forefront of practice.
lines.style: Patient, affirming. Professional pride without defensiveness. The tone of someone who believes in learning across institutions. Slight warmth on 'collaborate' — partnership matters.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、天空のヘリ救急を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes — helicopter emergency response is part of our team's critical care capability.
lines.style: Close and intimate. Still professional but the voice of someone trusting Ren with operational details. Slightly lower volume, as if drawing him into something important. No distance between them now.
